### Observed differences

- In the earlier window the segment A21 → A22 → A23 was mandatory and fixed: A22 occurred exactly once in every trace (200 of 200), always between A21 and A23 (A21 before A22 and A22 before A23 in 100% of traces), and the distance from A21 to A23 was always 2 steps. [OCC018, REL001, REL005, LAG001]
- In the later window A22 appears in only about half of the traces (102 of 200, down from 200), while three activities that were not observed at all earlier — A27, A28 and A33 — each appear in about 49% of traces (98 of 200). Where A22 still occurs, its position is unchanged (mean relative position about 0.50 in both windows). [OCC018, OCC019, OCC020, OCC025, POS002]
- In the later window, A21 leads to A22 in about 51% of its outgoing transitions and to A27, A28 or A33 in the remainder (roughly 15–18% each); the new activities in turn lead either to one another or directly to A23. [DIR014, DIR017, DIR018, DIR023]
- A22 and each of the three new activities never occur in the same trace in the later window (co-occurrence 0; about 51% of traces have A22 only, about 49% have the new activity only), so the two behaviours are strict alternatives within a case. [REL006, REL007, REL008]
- The three new activities run together as a group: each co-occurs with the other two in about 49% of later traces (the same share as its own participation), and both orders occur in similar proportions (for example A27 before A28 in about 23% and A28 before A27 in about 27% of traces), so the group has no fixed internal order. [REL012, REL013, REL014]
- Where the new activities run, the distance from A21 to A23 grows from 2 to 4 steps (49% of later traces), and the new activities sit near the middle of the trace (mean relative position about 0.49); A21 shifted slightly earlier (mean 0.46 → 0.44) and A23 slightly later (0.53 → 0.55), consistent with activities being inserted between them. [LAG001, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS001, POS003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that in the later window the segment between A21 and A23 is executed in two variants: in about half of the traces the original A21 → A22 → A23 sequence is retained, while in the other half A22 is skipped and a group of three activities — A27, A28 and A33 — runs between A21 and A23 in varying order. Since A27, A28 and A33 were not observed in the earlier window, this is a structural difference (an activity becoming optional and a new block appearing between A21 and A23), not a re-weighting of paths that already existed in both windows. [OCC018, OCC019, OCC020, OCC025, REL001, REL005, REL006, LAG001, DIR014]

The supporting signs are direct and consistent across indicator families: A21 now bypasses A22 in about half of its outgoing transitions; the new activities occur only after A21 and before A23; A22 and the new activities never share a trace; and the A21→A23 distance doubles exactly in the traces where the new activities run. The main items show empirical strengths of about 0.995, meaning differences larger than in 199 of 200 random re-splits of the same data, and the effect size (roughly 100 of 200 traces switching behaviour) is far too large to be a rare-variant artefact. [DIR014, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL009, REL010, REL011, LAG001, POS004, POS005, POS006]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window shows only that A27, A28 and A33 were not exercised there, not that they were absent from the process, so an unexercised pre-existing branch cannot be ruled out; the evidence also cannot show what triggers the choice between the two variants or what determines the internal order of the trio. [OCC019, REL012, REL013, REL014]

Other differences: several weaker shifts appear elsewhere and are not part of this hypothesis: A16 participation fell from about 45% to 40% while A17 rose from about 55% to 61%; A18's outgoing transitions shifted toward A25 (about 44% to 58%); A31 and A32 route more often to A26 (about 44% to 53%); and A40 routes more often to A37 (about 39% to 45%). These are small changes consistent with ordinary sampling variation between two windows of 200 traces. [OCC014, OCC015, DIR012, DIR021, DIR022, DIR028]
